queue.mechanism: Some insider transactions may contain information not immediately incorporated into price.
queue.who_pays: Counterparties slow to incorporate informative insider activity
queue.question: Does the already-built Form 4 event population show a gross post-event effect large enough to justify survivorship-safe mapping work?
queue.proxy: Existing SEC census + simple public EOD security price proxy; explicit survivorship/delist bias label
queue.kill_if: Gross effect is near zero or unstable before expensive data-chain cleanup.
queue.promote_if: Effect is economically large and consistent enough that CIK/security PIT, delists and corporate actions are worth reconstructing.

queue.mechanism: Fiscal-information surprises may temporarily reprice French sovereign risk relative to Germany.
queue.who_pays: Investors adjusting sovereign-risk exposure after fiscal information
queue.question: Is there a coarse relative OAT/Bund response around a fixed public event set large enough to justify futures-level reconstruction?
queue.proxy: Public daily sovereign-yield/index proxies with predeclared event set and horizon; no claim of executable PnL
queue.kill_if: No visible relative response even at coarse daily level.
queue.promote_if: Directionally coherent response is large enough to justify FOAT/FGBL, CTD, DV01, roll and cost work.

queue.mechanism: Policy announcements may create short-lived repricing when content surprises expectations.
queue.who_pays: Participants slower to process or reposition after policy information
queue.question: Can a small prospective sample show a repeatable sign/magnitude response without reconstructing historical famous events?
queue.proxy: Prospective official-source receipt clock + one predeclared liquid-market proxy/horizon
queue.kill_if: No meaningful response in the prospective sample after simple costs.
queue.promote_if: Repeated prospective response is large enough to justify historical PIT reconstruction.

queue.mechanism: Persistent directional liquidity demand may make top-of-book imbalance informative over short horizons.
queue.question: Can a short prospective, public, bounded order-book capture show an effect large enough to justify historical L2 work?
queue.proxy: Small prospective public order-book capture on a venue whose public access is permitted; fixed lagged signal, fixed horizon, fixed costs
queue.kill_if: No directional effect net of simple crossing/fee assumptions.
queue.promote_if: Effect is large and stable enough to justify deeper PIT/execution validation.
